name: design-guide-64
prompt: The attached images are STYLE references only (classic Korean MMORPG pixel art). For more of that style, browse these two games and study their character sprites: 바람의나라: 연 https://baramy.nexon.com/ and 도깨비의세계 https://dokkaebi.kakaogames.com/preregister/ . Learn from them: thick 1px dark outlines, dithered shading, saturated but limited palette, about 3 to 3.5 heads tall with a large head and voluminous hair, slight 3/4 top-down view, light coming from the upper left. Then draw a NEW original character (not a copy of any reference): a young court painter (도화서 화원) of a Joseon-fantasy world, the company's head designer, 29 years old, French - light chestnut-brown wavy hair tied up in a small topknot with a black horsehair headband (망건), NO hat, NO glasses, fair skin, two clearly visible dark eyes, a relaxed faint smile, a thin ink brush tucked behind his right ear (dark red-brown handle sticking out past the hair, white bristle tip). Clothing: a periwinkle-blue dopo robe (#4b5f9e) with a plum-purple belt cord (#5b3a63) tied at the waist with two hanging tails, over a white hanbok, white pants, black flat shoes. In his left hand he holds a small rectangular cream sketchbook (화첩) with a dark brown spine flat against his chest; his right hand hangs loosely. Requirements: one character, full body, idle standing pose, facing the viewer (south), centered on a flat solid magenta background (#FF00FF), no drop shadow, no text, no border, no scenery. Render as crisp pixel art about 64 pixels tall (head to feet), then upscale exactly 8x with nearest-neighbor so every logical pixel is a sharp 8x8 block on a 512x512 canvas, and give me that PNG to download.
note: 하네스가 시트 절을 64px 정지 그림 절로 바꿈 (대표 결정 2026-09-12)
